After Ng3+, if fxg3, Black loses the knight. If Kg1, then Black can play Kxb7 next. But this is less direct than just playing Kxb7 immediately.

**Best move: Kxb7** - This wins the undefended knight immediately. White's only try is Bxa7, but then Black plays Kxa7, winning another piece for just the a7 pawn, leaving Black up significant material.

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent leaves a piece undefended, capture it! Before playing a flashy tactic, check if you can simply take free material. The knight on b7 has no defender—your king can grab it safely. When your opponent recaptures on a7, your king is perfectly placed to win that piece too.
